heading: INT. BRANDVOLD TAXIDERMY - BACK ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. BRANDVOLD TAXIDERMY - BACK ROOM - NIGHT
Glass eyes glitter from every shelf: owls, a badger, a stuffed marlin mounted over the door.
Under a green lamp, a poker game is winding down.
OTTO BRANDVOLD, 60s, round and genial, shuffles with slow pride.
Across from him sits SILAS KEANE, 40s, lean, in a good suit gone shiny at the elbows.
TOM PELLETIER, 50s, a bruiser in a too-small vest, stacks his chips like bricks.
MAUDE ARCHIBALD, 50s, silver hair, pearl earrings, knits between hands.
RUBY LAMB, 20s, sharp-eyed, deals herself a cigarette and nothing else.
Gentlemen. Ladies. A toast before the last hand. To friends who stay friends.
units.name: OTTO

units.text: He pours amber into five small glasses.
Never turn down Otto's brandy.
units.name: TOM

units.text: Dear, you're not drinking.
units.name: MAUDE

units.text: I'm pacing myself.
units.name: RUBY

units.text: Silas lifts his glass, studies it against the lamp, sets it down untouched.
Nobody pours that generous for free.
units.name: SILAS

units.text: Something wrong, Silas?
units.name: OTTO

units.text: Just admiring the craftsmanship. Of the glass.
units.name: SILAS

units.text: Tom drains his and thumps the table.
Maude's needles click.
The marlin's shadow crawls across the felt.
Last hand. Everybody in?
units.name: OTTO

units.text: In.
units.name: ALL

units.text: Otto deals.
Tom sways, blinks hard, and tries to speak.
Nothing comes.
He slides sideways off his chair and lands among the sawdust.
Maude's needles stop.
Ruby stands, calm, and pockets the cards.
You didn't drink it.
units.name: RUBY

units.text: Neither did you.
units.name: SILAS

units.text: Two out of five. Not bad for a Tuesday.
units.name: OTTO

units.text: The back door opens.
FENWICK, 30s, rain on his shoulders, a badge in his raised hand and a revolver in the other.
Nobody touch the glasses. Otto, I've been waiting a year for this.
units.name: FENWICK

units.text: Otto smiles and sets down the bottle.
So has Maude.
units.name: OTTO

units.text: Maude lays her knitting aside.
Beneath it, a small pistol.
